title: Razor Crest
description: The Mandalorian traveled the galaxy in the Razor Crest—including to the desert planet of Tatooine—in search of bounties, information, or anything else he found useful in his quests. A military craft used to patrol in the time before the Empire, the Razor Crest was a classic, utilitarian ship. Din Djarin put it to good use as a bounty-hunting vessel, and it doubled as living quarters for him and Grogu in their adventures. That is until it was destroyed by Moff Gideon's Imperial Remnant on Tython, just before young Grogu was kidnapped.
